actions.convert-pdf-to-text.description: Converts PDF document to text file with markdown formatting.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.doctly_convert_document.descript: Starts converting a document to markdown.
actions.doctly_convert_document.props.ac: "lite" is faster and cheaper, "ultra" is more accurate. Defaults to the account setting.
actions.doctly_convert_document.props.fi: The document to process: a PDF, DOCX or image, as a file or a public URL.
actions.doctly_convert_document.props.pa: Whether to mark page breaks in the markdown. Defaults to true.
actions.doctly_convert_document.props.sk: Whether to leave out descriptions of images. Defaults to false.
actions.doctly_delete_document.descripti: Permanently deletes a document and its files.
actions.doctly_delete_document.props.doc: Document ID (UUID). Returned by Convert Document, Run Extractor and List Documents.
actions.doctly_delete_extractor.descript: Deletes an extractor from the account.
actions.doctly_delete_extractor.props.ex: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_get_document.description: Gets a document, its status and, once completed, its output.
actions.doctly_get_document.props.docume: Document ID (UUID). Returned by Convert Document, Run Extractor and List Documents.
actions.doctly_get_extractor.props.extra: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_get_extractor_upgrade_inf: Checks whether a newer version of an extractor is available.
Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_get_usage.description: Gets credit balance and monthly usage.
actions.doctly_get_usage.props.months.de: How many calendar months to include, counting the current one (1-36). Defaults to 12.
actions.doctly_list_documents.descriptio: Lists processed documents, newest first, with optional filters.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.date: Only documents created on or after this date, e.g. 2026-01-31.
Only documents created on or before this date, e.g. 2026-01-31.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.extr: Only documents run through this extractor (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.limi: Max documents to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.noEx: Set to true for plain markdown conversions only. Defaults to false.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.sear: Text to match in the file name.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.skip: How many documents to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.
actions.doctly_list_documents.props.user: Only documents uploaded by the user with this email.
Only documents uploaded by this user (UUID).
actions.doctly_list_extractors.descripti: Lists the extractors available in the account.
actions.doctly_list_extractors.props.lim: Max extractors to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.
actions.doctly_list_extractors.props.ski: How many extractors to skip, for paging. Defaults to 0.
actions.doctly_remix_extractor.descripti: Creates an editable copy of an extractor.
actions.doctly_remix_extractor.props.ext: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_run_extractor.description: Starts running an extractor on a document.
The document to process: a PDF, DOCX or image, as a file or a public URL.
actions.doctly_run_extractor.props.input: Optional runtime inputs the extractor defines, as a JSON object.
The extractor's slug, e.g. "invoice-parser". Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_update_extractor.descript: Updates an extractor's name, slug or description.
actions.doctly_update_extractor.props.ex: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
actions.doctly_upgrade_extractor.descrip: Upgrades an extractor to its latest version.
actions.doctly_upgrade_extractor.props.e: Extractor ID (UUID). Use List Extractors to find it.
